text:
ana_ops: Quick PM follow-up: persistent noisy pages from auth-layer (403 bursts). Need owners + short ETAs for dedupe, thresholds, suppression, canary, and monthly churn audit. Tracker: https://go/internal/remediation-auth.

joel_oncall: I can own dedupe + short suppression. Proposal: key = client_id|route|hash(body,6), suppression 180s. Will prototype in staging and open a PR.

ravi_sre: I'll take thresholds + audit cadence. Plan: nudge client-scoped threshold +15% then monitor 7 days; add global p99 spike alert to avoid hiding real failures. Will build dashboards to measure unique keys vs pages.

maya_dev: I'll add the hash util and a small synthetic that replays a retry-loop for the canary. Suggest rollout: staging -> 5% prod 48h -> full. ETA for hash util + synthetic: 4d.

ops-bot: Incident 2029-11-03: auth-layer 403 spike -> 30 pages, peak 02:10 UTC.

ana_ops: small correction: tracker link updated and we should tag GH issues with "pm-followup/alert-tuning". Sync Friday 09:30 UTC to check PRs and dashboards. If canary reduces pages by >60% over 48h we close short-term actions.

joel_oncall: PR opened for paging config changes, marking WIP.

ravi_sre: Baseline metrics posted in tracker. I'll monitor post-canary.

maya_dev: Can confirm synthetic harness wired; will request canary quota.

ana_ops: Thanks team. If anyone hits infra quota or needs help with client outreach ping me directly.
